reviewCharts.warning: Washington native review rows use the official participating county precinct CSV for presidential vote-share screening and President-versus-U.S. Senate same-party drop-off screening. The precinct export aggregates to 3,918,934 presidential votes, 5,309 fewer than the certified county presidential total of 3,924,243, so review charts must be treated as official participating-precinct screening rather than a fully reconciled statewide precinct dataset.

turnout.notes: Washington turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout-denominator artifact is collected.

historicalBaselines.warning: Washington historical baseline rows are official county-level 2016 and 2020 presidential results from Washington Secretary of State all-counties CSV exports. Use them as contextual jurisdictionTag flip baselines, not as 2024 certified-result rows. Official 2012 county presidential baselines remain uncollected.
